CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.deliver_internal_notifications()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n public.requisition_notifications;allowed boolean;begin
 for n in select * from public.requisition_notifications where channel='internal' and state='pending' and next_attempt_at<=now() order by created_at for update skip locked limit 100 loop
 allowed:=case
 when n.document_id is not null then private.member_can(n.care_recipient_id,n.recipient_user_id,(select lower(type)||'.read' from public.operational_documents where id=n.document_id))
 when n.requisition_id is not null then private.member_can(n.care_recipient_id,n.recipient_user_id,'req.read')
 when n.alert_event_id is not null then exists(select 1 from public.stock_alert_events e where e.id=n.alert_event_id and e.state='open' and private.member_can(n.care_recipient_id,n.recipient_user_id,case when e.location='FAMILY' then 'stock.family.read' else 'stock.team.read' end))
 when n.consumption_report_id is not null then exists(select 1 from public.consumption_reports r where r.id=n.consumption_report_id and (r.reported_by=n.recipient_user_id or private.member_can(n.care_recipient_id,n.recipient_user_id,'consumption.confirm')) and private.member_can(n.care_recipient_id,n.recipient_user_id,'consumption.report'))
 when n.reminder_id is not null then exists(select 1 from public.operational_reminders r where r.id=n.reminder_id and r.user_id=n.recipient_user_id and r.acknowledged_at is null and private.reminder_recipient_can(r.id,n.recipient_user_id)) else false end;
 update public.requisition_notifications set state=case when coalesce(allowed,false) then 'delivered' else 'cancelled' end,delivered_at=case when allowed then now() end,attempted_at=now(),attempts=attempts+1,provider_reference=case when allowed then 'internal' end where id=n.id;
 end loop;
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.record_document_event(p_id uuid, p_action text, p_body jsonb, p_key uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare d public.operational_documents;s jsonb;h text;actors jsonb;begin
 select * into strict d from public.operational_documents where id=p_id for update;
 actors:=jsonb_build_object('issuer',coalesce(d.canonical_snapshot->'actors'->'issuer',(select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',full_name,'registration',professional_registration,'state',professional_state,'category',professional_category) from public.profiles where id=d.created_by)),
 'recipient',(select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',full_name,'registration',professional_registration,'state',professional_state,'category',professional_category) from public.profiles where id=d.recipient_id),
 'patient',coalesce(d.canonical_snapshot->'actors'->'patient',(select jsonb_build_object('id',id,'name',display_name) from public.care_recipients where id=d.care_recipient_id)));
 s:=jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion',2,'id',d.id,'careRecipientId',d.care_recipient_id,'type',d.type,'code',d.code,'protocol',d.protocol,'createdAt',d.created_at,
 'status',d.status,'createdBy',d.created_by,'recipientId',d.recipient_id,'actors',actors,'payload',d.payload,'workflow',d.workflow_data,
 'lines',case when d.type='REQ' then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) order by i.id) from public.requisition_items i where requisition_id=d.id),'[]') else coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l) order by l.product_id) from public.document_lines l where document_id=p_id),'[]') end,
 'approvals',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a)) from public.bal_approvals a where document_id=p_id),'[]'),
 'itemResolutions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) order by r.id) from public.requisition_item_resolutions r join public.requisition_items i on i.id=r.requisition_item_id where i.requisition_id=p_id),'[]'),
 'requestLinks',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k)) from public.document_request_links k join public.document_lines l on l.id=k.document_line_id where l.document_id=p_id),'[]'),
 'attachments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'filename',filename,'sha256',sha256,'bytes',bytes)) from public.attachments where document_id=p_id and state='ready'),'[]'),
 'version',d.version,'action',p_action,'event',p_body,'previousHash',d.content_hash);
 h:=encode(extensions.digest(s::text,'sha256'),'hex');
 update public.operational_documents set canonical_snapshot=s,content_hash=h,updated_at=now() where id=p_id;
 insert into public.document_events(document_id,care_recipient_id,version,action,actor_id,body,content_hash,idempotency_key) values(p_id,d.care_recipient_id,d.version,p_action,auth.uid(),s,h,p_key);
 insert into public.audit_events(actor_id,action,entity_type,entity_id,metadata) values(auth.uid(),p_action,'document',p_id,jsonb_build_object('care_recipient_id',d.care_recipient_id,'type',d.type,'version',d.version));
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.balance_workspace(p_patient uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_a public.bal_assignments;v_doc uuid;v_available boolean:=false;v_enabled boolean;begin
 perform private.require_cap(p_patient,'bal.read');
 select enabled into v_enabled from public.bal_regimes where care_recipient_id=p_patient;
 select * into v_a from public.bal_assignments where care_recipient_id=p_patient and status='active';
 if found then
 select document_id into v_doc from public.bal_cycles where id=v_a.cycle_id;
 v_available:=v_a.professional_id=auth.uid() and private.can(p_patient,'bal.count') and v_a.starts_at<=now() and v_a.ends_at>now()
 and exists(select 1 from public.scheduled_shifts s where s.id=v_a.shift_id and s.status='published' and s.version=v_a.shift_version)
 and private.schedule_worker(p_patient,auth.uid());end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('referenceRevision',private.team_revision(p_patient)::text,'enabled',coalesce(v_enabled,false),'regime',(select to_jsonb(r) from public.bal_regimes r where care_recipient_id=p_patient),
 'eligibility',jsonb_build_object('available',v_available,'assignment',case when v_a.id is not null then to_jsonb(v_a) end,'documentId',v_doc,'href','/fichas/bal','dueAt',v_a.ends_at),
 'types',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.starts_local,t.name) from public.shift_types t where t.care_recipient_id=p_patient),'[]'),
 'professionals',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'name',p.full_name) order by p.full_name) from public.profiles p where private.schedule_worker(p_patient,p.id) and private.member_can(p_patient,p.id,'bal.count')),'[]'),'obligations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.week_start desc) from (select * from public.bal_obligations where care_recipient_id=p_patient order by week_start desc limit 104) x),'[]'),
 'assignments',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)||jsonb_build_object('professional_name',p.full_name,'type_name',t.name) order by x.created_at desc)
 from (select * from public.bal_assignments where care_recipient_id=p_patient order by created_at desc limit 200) x join public.profiles p on p.id=x.professional_id join public.scheduled_shifts s on s.id=x.shift_id join public.shift_types t on t.id=s.shift_type_id),'[]'),
 'deferrals',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.created_at desc) from (select * from public.bal_deferrals where care_recipient_id=p_patient order by created_at desc limit 100) x),'[]'),
 'events',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.created_at desc) from (select * from public.bal_cycle_events where care_recipient_id=p_patient order by created_at desc limit 200) x),'[]'),
 'targets',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('professional_name',p.full_name,'type_name',t.name) order by s.starts_at)
 from public.scheduled_shifts s join public.profiles p on p.id=s.professional_id join public.shift_types t on t.id=s.shift_type_id
 where s.care_recipient_id=p_patient and s.status='published' and s.ends_at>now() and s.starts_at<now()+interval '35 days'
 and private.schedule_worker(p_patient,s.professional_id) and private.member_can(p_patient,s.professional_id,'bal.count')),'[]'));
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.configure_recipient_notification(p_care_recipient_id uuid, p_recipient_user_id uuid, p_recipient_group text, p_channel text, p_destination text, p_enabled boolean, p_include_team_alerts boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS recipient_notification_settings
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v public.recipient_notification_settings;
begin
  if not public.recipient_can(p_care_recipient_id,'admin') then raise exception 'notification admin authorization required' using errcode='42501';end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from public.profiles p where p.id=p_recipient_user_id and p.status='active' and
    (p.role='admin' and p.global_scope or exists(select 1 from public.care_recipient_memberships m
      where m.user_id=p.id and m.care_recipient_id=p_care_recipient_id and m.status='active')))
  then raise exception 'recipient is not an active patient member';end if;
  if p_recipient_group is null or p_recipient_group not in ('family','supervision','care_team','other')
    or p_channel is null or p_channel not in ('internal','email','whatsapp') or p_enabled is null
    or p_include_team_alerts is null
    or p_channel<>'internal' and (p_destination is null or length(trim(p_destination)) not between 3 and 254)
    or p_channel='email' and p_destination!~'^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$'
    or p_channel='whatsapp' and p_destination!~'^[+][1-9][0-9]{7,14}$'
  then raise exception 'invalid notification destination';end if;
  insert into public.recipient_notification_settings(
    care_recipient_id,recipient_user_id,recipient_group,channel,destination,is_enabled,include_team_alerts
  ) values(p_care_recipient_id,p_recipient_user_id,p_recipient_group,p_channel,
    case when p_channel='internal' then null else trim(p_destination) end,p_enabled,
    p_recipient_group='family' and p_include_team_alerts)
  on conflict(care_recipient_id,recipient_user_id,channel) do update set
    recipient_group=excluded.recipient_group,destination=excluded.destination,
    is_enabled=excluded.is_enabled,include_team_alerts=excluded.include_team_alerts returning * into v;
  insert into public.audit_events(actor_id,action,entity_type,entity_id,metadata)
  values(auth.uid(),'notification.settings.updated','notification_setting',v.id,
    jsonb_build_object('care_recipient_id',p_care_recipient_id,'channel',p_channel,
      'enabled',p_enabled,'include_team_alerts',v.include_team_alerts));
  return v;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fluent_pre_retry_claim_jobs(p_limit integer, p_worker_id uuid, p_external_enabled boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS SETOF requisition_notifications
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_global_administrator() and coalesce(auth.role(),'')<>'service_role'
  then raise exception 'worker authorization required' using errcode='42501';end if;
  if p_worker_id is null then raise exception 'worker identity required';end if;
  update public.requisition_notifications set
    state=case when channel='internal' then 'pending' else 'uncertain' end,
    leased_by=null,lease_expires_at=null,last_error='processing lease expired'
    where state='processing' and lease_expires_at<now();
  update public.requisition_notifications n set state='cancelled',last_error='recipient access revoked'
    where n.state='pending' and not exists(select 1 from public.profiles p
      where p.id=n.recipient_user_id and p.status='active' and
        (p.role='admin' and p.global_scope or exists(select 1 from public.care_recipient_memberships m
          where m.care_recipient_id=n.care_recipient_id and m.user_id=p.id and m.status='active')));
  -- An alert resolved before its send is no longer actionable. Preserve the
  -- outbox row as cancelled instead of sending an obsolete warning.
  update public.requisition_notifications n set state='cancelled',last_error='stock alert resolved before send'
    where n.state='pending' and n.alert_event_id is not null and exists(
      select 1 from public.stock_alert_events e where e.id=n.alert_event_id and e.state='resolved');
  return query update public.requisition_notifications n set state='processing',
    attempts=n.attempts+1,attempted_at=now(),leased_by=p_worker_id,
    lease_expires_at=now()+interval '2 minutes'
    where n.id in (
      select candidate.id from public.requisition_notifications candidate
      left join public.stock_alert_events e on e.id=candidate.alert_event_id
      where candidate.state='pending'
        and (candidate.channel='internal' or candidate.channel='whatsapp' and coalesce(p_external_enabled,false))
        and candidate.next_attempt_at<=now() and candidate.attempts<5
      order by case when e.severity='critical' then 0 else 1 end,
        candidate.next_attempt_at,candidate.id
      for update of candidate skip locked
      limit greatest(1,least(coalesce(p_limit,50),100))
    ) returning n.*;
end; $function$

routines.name: operational_document_list
routines.signature: p_patient uuid, p_type text, p_status text, p_search text, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_page integer, p_size integer
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.operational_document_list(p_patient uuid, p_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_size integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;begin
 if not public.can_access_recipient(p_patient) then raise exception 'patient operating context required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if p_page not between 1 and 100000 or p_size not between 1 and 100 or p_type is not null and p_type not in ('REQ','COM','ENT','BAL') then raise exception 'invalid document filter';end if;
 with counts as materialized (
 select i.requisition_id,count(*) total,count(*) filter(where exists(select 1 from public.document_request_links k join public.document_lines l on l.id=k.document_line_id join public.operational_documents d on d.id=l.document_id where k.requisition_item_id=i.id and d.type='ENT' and d.status<>'cancelled' and l.accepted_quantity>0)) fulfilled
 from public.requisition_items i where i.care_recipient_id=p_patient group by i.requisition_id),
 visible as materialized (
 select d.id,d.type,d.code,d.protocol,d.recipient_id,d.created_at,d.version,
 case when exists(select 1 from public.requisitions r where r.id=d.id and r.is_historical) then 'historical' when d.type<>'REQ' or d.status in ('cancelled','draft') then d.status when s.archived_at is not null then 'archived'
 when s.completed_at is not null then case when private.science_satisfied(d.id) then 'completed' else 'completed_science_pending' end
 when coalesce(c.fulfilled,0)>0 then 'fulfillment_partial' when not coalesce(private.science_satisfied(d.id),false) then 'science_pending' else 'awaiting_fulfillment' end status,
 case when d.type='REQ' then jsonb_build_object('fulfilled',coalesce(c.fulfilled,0),'total',coalesce(c.total,0)) end fulfillment,
 case when d.type='REQ' then jsonb_build_object('scienceSatisfied',coalesce(private.science_satisfied(d.id),false),'completedAt',s.completed_at,'archivedAt',s.archived_at,'manualArchiveRequired',s.manual_archive_required) end progress,
 case when d.type='ENT' then coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',l.id,'fully_checked',l.fully_checked,'accepted_quantity',l.accepted_quantity::text,'quantity',l.quantity::text)) from public.document_lines l where l.document_id=d.id),'[]') end document_lines
 from public.operational_documents d left join counts c on c.requisition_id=d.id left join public.requisition_lifecycle s on s.requisition_id=d.id
 where d.care_recipient_id=p_patient and private.can(p_patient,lower(d.type)||'.read') and (p_type is null or d.type=p_type)
 and (p_from is null or d.created_at>=p_from) and (p_to is null or d.created_at<p_to)
 and (p_search is null or d.code ilike '%'||p_search||'%' or d.protocol ilike '%'||p_search||'%')),
 filtered as materialized(select * from visible where p_status is null or case p_status when 'archive_pending' then private.requisition_archive_task(id) when 'science_required' then private.requisition_science_task(id,auth.uid()) else status=p_status end),
 paged as(select * from filtered order by created_at desc,id offset (p_page-1)*p_size limit p_size)
 select jsonb_build_object('data',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by created_at desc,id) from paged p),'[]'),'total',(select count(*) from filtered),'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_size) into result;
 return result;
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.operational_tasks(p_patient uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;open_count integer;science_count integer;archive_count integer;begin
 if not public.can_access_recipient(p_patient) then raise exception 'patient operating context required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 result:=public.v3_operational_tasks(p_patient);
 select count(*) filter(where s.completed_at is null),count(*) filter(where private.requisition_science_task(d.id,auth.uid())),
 count(*) filter(where private.requisition_archive_task(d.id)) into open_count,science_count,archive_count
 from public.operational_documents d join public.requisition_lifecycle s on s.requisition_id=d.id where d.care_recipient_id=p_patient and d.type='REQ' and d.status not in ('draft','cancelled') and s.archived_at is null and private.can(p_patient,'req.read') and not exists(select 1 from public.requisitions r where r.id=d.id and r.is_historical);
 return result||jsonb_build_object('requests',open_count,'sciencePending',science_count,'archivePending',archive_count);
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.schedule_workspace(p_patient uuid, p_from date, p_until date)

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 if not(private.can(p_patient,'schedule.read.team') or private.can(p_patient,'schedule.read.own')) then raise exception 'schedule authorization required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if p_from is null or p_until is null or p_until<p_from or p_until>p_from+42 then raise exception 'invalid schedule interval';end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('types',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.starts_local,t.name) from public.shift_types t where t.care_recipient_id=p_patient),'[]'),
 'shifts',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('professional_name',p.full_name,'type_name',t.name) order by s.starts_at,p.full_name)
 from public.scheduled_shifts s join public.profiles p on p.id=s.professional_id join public.shift_types t on t.id=s.shift_type_id
 where s.care_recipient_id=p_patient and private.schedule_visible(p_patient,s.professional_id)
 and s.starts_at<((p_until+1)::timestamp at time zone s.timezone) and s.ends_at>(p_from::timestamp at time zone s.timezone)),'[]'),
 'professionals',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'name',p.full_name) order by p.full_name)
 from public.profiles p where private.schedule_worker(p_patient,p.id) and (private.can(p_patient,'schedule.read.team') or private.can(p_patient,'schedule.propose') or p.id=auth.uid())),'[]'),
 'changes',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) order by c.created_at desc) from public.shift_change_requests c where c.care_recipient_id=p_patient
 and private.schedule_visible(p_patient,c.professional_id) and c.status='pending'),'[]'),
 'series',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) order by s.created_at desc) from public.shift_series s where s.care_recipient_id=p_patient
 and private.schedule_visible(p_patient,s.professional_id) and s.valid_until>=p_from and s.anchor_date<=p_until),'[]'),
 'events',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) order by e.created_at desc) from (select * from public.shift_events where care_recipient_id=p_patient
 and private.schedule_visible(p_patient,professional_id) order by created_at desc limit 100) e),'[]'));

 and destination_location is null and reference_type='consumption'

 group by product_id,source_location)x),'[]');

AS $function$
declare family boolean:=private.can(p_patient,'stock.family.read');team boolean:=private.can(p_patient,'stock.team.read');begin
 if not(family or team) then raise exception 'stock permission required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if p_page is null or p_page<1 or p_size is null or p_size not between 1 and 100 or p_location is not null and p_location not in ('FAMILY','CARE_TEAM','TRANSIT') then raise exception 'invalid history filter';end if;
 return (with scoped as(select * from public.stock_movements where care_recipient_id=p_patient
 and (family or team and (source_location in ('CARE_TEAM','TRANSIT') or destination_location in ('CARE_TEAM','TRANSIT')))
 and (p_product is null or product_id=p_product) and (p_from is null or created_at>=p_from) and (p_to is null or created_at<p_to)
 and (p_location is null or source_location=p_location or destination_location=p_location)),
 paged as(select * from scoped order by created_at desc,id desc limit p_size offset (p_page-1)*p_size)
 select jsonb_build_object('total',(select count(*) from scoped),'data',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)-'payload_hash'-'idempotency_key' order by x.created_at desc,x.id desc) from (
 select s.id,s.product_id,s.quantity::text,s.movement_type,s.source_location,s.destination_location,s.justification,s.created_at,s.performed_by,s.reference_type,s.reference_id,
 case when family or s.source_location<>'FAMILY' then s.source_balance_before end source_balance_before,
 case when family or s.source_location<>'FAMILY' then s.source_balance_after end source_balance_after,
 case when family or s.destination_location<>'FAMILY' then s.destination_balance_before end destination_balance_before,
 case when family or s.destination_location<>'FAMILY' then s.destination_balance_after end destination_balance_after
 from paged s) x),'[]')));
end;$function$

routines.name: stock_overview
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stock_overview(p_patient uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare family boolean:=private.can(p_patient,'stock.family.read');team boolean:=private.can(p_patient,'stock.team.read');begin
 if not(family or team) then raise exception 'stock permission required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('productId',c.product_id,'name',c.name,'unit',c.unit,'decimals',c.quantity_decimals,'active',c.is_active,
 'family',case when family then jsonb_build_object('confirmed',private.stock_quantity(p_patient,c.product_id,'FAMILY')::text,
 'incoming',coalesce((select sum(l.quantity-l.accepted_quantity-l.reconciled_quantity) from public.document_lines l join public.operational_documents d on d.id=l.document_id where d.care_recipient_id=p_patient and d.type='ENT' and d.payload->>'destination'='FAMILY' and d.status in ('pending_receipt','disputed','cancellation_pending') and l.product_id=c.product_id),0)::text,
 'purchasePending',coalesce((select sum(l.approved_quantity-l.accepted_quantity) from public.document_lines l join public.operational_documents d on d.id=l.document_id where d.care_recipient_id=p_patient and d.type='COM' and d.status in ('approved','partially_approved','purchasing','purchased','partially_received') and l.product_id=c.product_id),0)::text,
 'minimum',(select low_threshold from public.stock_alert_rules where care_recipient_id=p_patient and product_id=c.product_id and location='FAMILY' and is_enabled)) else null end,
 'team',case when team then jsonb_build_object('confirmed',private.stock_quantity(p_patient,c.product_id,'CARE_TEAM')::text,
 'incoming',coalesce((select sum(l.quantity-l.accepted_quantity-l.reconciled_quantity) from public.document_lines l join public.operational_documents d on d.id=l.document_id where d.care_recipient_id=p_patient and d.type='ENT' and d.payload->>'destination'='CARE_TEAM' and d.status in ('pending_receipt','disputed','cancellation_pending') and l.product_id=c.product_id),0)::text,
 'minimum',(select low_threshold from public.stock_alert_rules where care_recipient_id=p_patient and product_id=c.product_id and location='CARE_TEAM' and is_enabled)) else null end,
 'disputed',coalesce((select sum(l.quantity-l.accepted_quantity-l.reconciled_quantity) from public.document_lines l join public.operational_documents d on d.id=l.document_id where d.care_recipient_id=p_patient and d.type='ENT' and d.status in ('disputed','cancellation_pending') and l.product_id=c.product_id),0)::text) order by c.category,c.sort_order,c.name)
 from public.care_recipient_products c where c.care_recipient_id=p_patient),'[]');
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.stock_transit(p_patient uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not private.can(p_patient,'ent.read') then raise exception 'ENT permission required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'id',d.id,'code',d.code,'status',d.status,'createdAt',d.created_at,
 'source',d.payload->>'source','destination',d.payload->>'destination',
 'recipientId',d.recipient_id,
 'lines',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('productId',l.product_id,'name',l.name_snapshot,
 'unit',l.unit_snapshot,'dispatched',l.quantity::text,'accepted',l.accepted_quantity::text,
 'reconciled',l.reconciled_quantity::text,'pending',(l.quantity-l.accepted_quantity-l.reconciled_quantity)::text,
 'disputed',coalesce((l.metadata->>'issueOpen')::boolean,false)) order by l.name_snapshot)
 from public.document_lines l where l.document_id=d.id))
 order by d.created_at desc,d.id) from public.operational_documents d
 where d.care_recipient_id=p_patient and d.type='ENT'
 and d.status in ('pending_receipt','disputed','cancellation_pending')),'[]');
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.v3_notification_webhook(p_provider_reference text, p_state text, p_notification_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$begin
  if coalesce(auth.role(),'')<>'service_role' then raise exception 'service authorization required' using errcode='42501';end if;
  if p_provider_reference is null or p_state is null or p_state not in ('accepted','delivered','read','failed') then raise exception 'invalid provider event';end if;
  update public.requisition_notifications set state=p_state,provider_reference=coalesce(provider_reference,p_provider_reference),
    delivered_at=case when p_state in ('delivered','read') then coalesce(delivered_at,now()) else delivered_at end,
    read_at=case when p_state='read' then coalesce(read_at,now()) else read_at end,
    leased_by=null,lease_expires_at=null
  where (provider_reference=p_provider_reference or id=p_notification_id and provider_reference is null)
    and state in ('processing','accepted','uncertain','delivered','read')
    and (p_state='read' or p_state='delivered' and state<>'read' or p_state in ('accepted','failed') and state in ('processing','accepted','uncertain'));
end;$function$

routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.v3_operational_tasks(p_patient uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare s jsonb;due date;today date:=(now() at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date;begin
 if not public.can_access_recipient(p_patient) then raise exception 'patient permission required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 select settings into s from public.patient_settings where care_recipient_id=p_patient;
 if s->>'balDay' is not null then due:=today-((extract(dow from today)::integer-(s->>'balDay')::integer+7)%7);end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('requests',(select count(*) from public.requisitions r where care_recipient_id=p_patient and status not in ('cancelled','draft') and exists(select 1 from public.requisition_items i where requisition_id=r.id and not exists(select 1 from public.document_request_links k join public.document_lines l on l.id=k.document_line_id join public.operational_documents d on d.id=l.document_id where k.requisition_item_id=i.id and d.type='ENT' and d.status<>'cancelled' and l.accepted_quantity>0))),
 'balDay',s->'balDay','balDue',due,'balOverdue',due is not null and not exists(select 1 from public.operational_documents where care_recipient_id=p_patient and type='BAL' and status='approved' and (created_at at time zone 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date>=due),
 'drafts',(select count(*) from public.operational_documents where care_recipient_id=p_patient and status='draft' and created_by=auth.uid()),
 'consumptionPending',(select count(*) from public.consumption_reports where care_recipient_id=p_patient and status='reported' and case when location='FAMILY' then private.can(p_patient,'stock.family.manage') else private.can(p_patient,'consumption.confirm') end));
end;$function$

views.name: current_stock_balances
views.definition:
SELECT care_recipient_id,
    product_id,
    location,
    sum(delta) AS balance
   FROM ( SELECT stock_movements.care_recipient_id,
            stock_movements.product_id,
            stock_movements.destination_location AS location,
            stock_movements.quantity AS delta
           FROM stock_movements
          WHERE (stock_movements.destination_location IS NOT NULL)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT stock_movements.care_recipient_id,
            stock_movements.product_id,
            stock_movements.source_location,
            (- stock_movements.quantity)
           FROM stock_movements
          WHERE (stock_movements.source_location IS NOT NULL)) x
  WHERE ((care_recipient_id IS NOT NULL) AND
        CASE location
            WHEN 'FAMILY'::text THEN private.can(care_recipient_id, 'stock.family.read'::text)
            WHEN 'CARE_TEAM'::text THEN private.can(care_recipient_id, 'stock.team.read'::text)
            ELSE private.can(care_recipient_id, 'ent.read'::text)
        END)
  GROUP BY care_recipient_id, product_id, location;
